newsitem.title: TURKEY: Gunmen massacre ten in Turkish family home.
newsitem.headline: Gunmen massacre ten in Turkish family home.

text.p: Ten people, including eight from the same family, were killed when assailants sprayed automatic gunfire inside an Istanbul house on Sunday in an apparent family feud, Turkish officials and television said.
"Ten people, among them two children and five women, were shot dead," a local police commissioner told Reuters.
An official at the Istanbul's governor's office said the incident was believed to be part of a dispute among family members.
The ATV television station showed footage of blood stains on upturned beds in the house. Interior walls were pockmarked with dozens of bullet holes and splashed with blood.
"There were no witnesses but the attackers were believed to be two people because two guns, a pistol and an automatic rifle, were used," the official said.
The gunmen attacked the single-storey house in the city's run down Esenler district at 4 a.m. (0100 GMT).

Anatolian news agency said the family was from Siirt province in the mainly-Kurdish southeast of Turkey but the governor's office official said most of the dead were registered in the Mediterranean city of Mersin.
Blood feuds, some lasting decades, are common in some rural areas of Turkey.
